newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end sharply higher led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end sharply higher led by blue chips.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed sharply higher on Wednesday after waves of buying of blue-chip shares cancelled out losses caused by profit-taking in sectors such as banks, brokers said.
Banks had been propped up by short-covering in recent sessions, they said.
The Nikkei average finished at 18,735.47 after gaining 191.02 points or 1.03 percent, its highest close since Febraury 27, when it ended at 19,021. Its June futures ended 220 points up at 18,770.
"Fundamentals have improved greatly as pension funds are continuing to buy," said Keji Karikomi at Daiwa Securities.
